title: Collections
subtitle: Bring files, notes and meetings together for one purpose without moving them. Ask each collection questions, or turn it into a brief or a report section.
footnote: A record can sit in several collections. Removing it from one never deletes it.

empty.title: No collections yet
empty.body: Gather the files, notes and meetings you need for a “Q3 donor report”, for example. Or set up a smart collection that keeps itself up to date, like “Reports from KÇD”.

form.title: New collection
form.description: Records stay where they are; a collection gathers them in one place.
form.name: Name
form.aboutPlaceholder: Who will read it, and when is it needed? (optional)
form.smartHint: Records that match the conditions join by themselves. Anything you add by hand stays too.
form.wordsHint: Words in the title, the text or inside the file.
form.kindsHint: Pick none to include every kind.
form.datesError: The end date can’t be before the start date.
form.noCondition: You haven’t set a condition yet.
form.noMatch: Nothing matches right now. New records join as soon as they match.
form.matchMany: More than 100 records match. You may want to narrow the conditions.
form.matchCount: {count, plural, one {# record matches} other {# records match}} right now
form.pinHint: Shows in the sidebar under Files.

sources.title: Sources · {count}
sources.addPlaceholder: Search to add: file, note, meeting, task…
sources.empty: No sources yet. Add files, notes, meetings or tasks; they stay where they are.
sources.emptySmart: Nothing matches the filter right now. You can add records by hand too.
sources.aiOff: Kept away from AI; Claude doesn’t read this
sources.offNote: {count, plural, one {# source is} other {# sources are}} kept away from AI and not used in chat or outputs.

chat.title: Chat
chat.notConnectedBody: Once ANTHROPIC_API_KEY is added you can ask this collection questions and turn it into briefs and report sections.
chat.introBody: Claude answers only from the {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}} here, and shows where each fact comes from, down to the page.
chat.introEmpty: Add sources first: files, notes, meetings. Then you can ask about them.

examples.0: What are the main findings in these sources?
examples.1: Which numbers are reported, and for which period?
examples.2: What open questions and risks come up?

chat.reading: Claude is reading {count, plural, one {# source} other {# sources}}…
chat.nothing: I found nothing in the selected sources for “{question}”. Could you ask in other words?
chat.placeholderEmpty: Select at least one source to ask

studio.title: Outputs
studio.notConnected: Once AI is connected you can make briefs, talking points, slide outlines, partner emails and report sections here.

hints.brief: One page: key points, numbers, open questions, next steps
hints.talking_points: What to say in a meeting or a call, and likely questions
hints.slide_outline: 5–8 slides, each with bullets and a speaker note
hints.partner_email: A short email draft to a partner, with requests and dates
hints.section: A section in donor-report style: what was done, results, challenges

studio.needSources: Select at least one source to make an output.
studio.focusPlaceholder: e.g. only the Q3 field visits and households reached
studio.fromSources: Written from {count, plural, one {the # selected source} other {the # selected sources}}. The result is a draft that comes with its sources.
studio.draftNote: A draft; check it against the sources before you use it.
studio.fromReport: Written from {count, plural, one {the report's # source} other {the report's # sources}}. The result is a draft that comes with its sources.
studio.needReportSources: Add sources to the report first to make an output.
